# Skill Proficiency

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SkillProficiency`](gmeow-SkillProficiency.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SkillProficiency>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/expertise`](../../slices/expertise.md)

A reified, leveled proficiency of an agent in a skill — the [gufo:Relator](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator) binding {agent} × {skill} × {level on a scale} × {interval}, mirroring languages' [`gmeow:LanguageProficiency`](gmeow-LanguageProficiency.md). Mint one per (agent, skill) so per-skill levels coexist; the flat [`gmeow:hasSkill`](../properties/gmeow-hasSkill.md) relation states that an agent has a skill, this relator adds the level and the scale.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SkillProficiency`](gmeow-SkillProficiency.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
